narr: Abundant moisture remained over the region with an upper trough approaching from the west. Weak mid-level flow kept storms slow moving resulting in areas receiving over 2 inches of rain leading to flash flooding and debris flows around the Soldier Canyon burn area.
ev: A spotter reported torrential downpour with a lot of fast moving running water near their residence. The flood waters damaged a few of their fences.

Recent heavy rain and an additional 1 to 3 inches of rain brought debris flow down from the Soldier Canyon burn scar. The Emergency Manager reported Round Mountain Road was closed from 4 feet of mud and debris.
lsr: TORRENTIAL DOWNPOUR WITH LOTS OF FAST RUNNING WATER NEAR THEIR RESIDENCE. THE FLOOD WATERS DAMAGED A FEW OF THEIR FENCES.
